labels: existing per-fold PR-UAS OOF_FROZEN_PRIVATE.pt contains original FIT only; read patient/channel/y_nez fields only; ignore all teacher scores/uncertainty; no checkpoint loaded
alignment: reuse exact CoTAR canonical name/time/genuine2s mask; original nine-descriptor finite-mask validity, but only specified seven values are inputs; raw float64 window values retained
reference_channels: all genuinely observed source-cache channels of SAME selected patient's SAME seizure, including unlabelled nonquery channels; queries restricted to frozen7635 canonical pairs
stage_bounds: left inclusive,right exclusive, actual center timestamps, no rounding/interpolation
baseline: query-channel median over >=1 genuine preictal observation; missing -> NaN, never substitute zero
synchronous: median of finite baseline-qualified same-time other-channel d; query excluded; >=4 other channels; missing -> NaN
summary: per feature/stage finite mean,population std,OLS slope at actual timestamps; single observation slope0 with count ledger; missing -> NaN
record_aggregation: masked equal-seizure mean,population std of each summary coordinate and baseline; count ledger separate; single observed seizure std0

arms.C2: same self and baseline +shifted u summaries

shift: first64bitsSHA256 of seed42|patient|run|sample|channel|stage; nonzero1+(hash mod(n_valid-1)); per feature use same hash with its valid n; roll ONLY finite context positions inside each stage; n<2 unchanged; masks and multisets exact
control_gate_scope: label-free all selected80; no feature/patient filtering to pass, constant sequences remain denominator; gates fixed before construction

nested.selection_split: sorted remaining IDs, default_rng(42+1009*fold+10000+inner).permutation; first ceil20% threshold selection; remaining train
nested.fit_role_interpretation: per corresponding original fold, not global exclusion of union of other folds' validation IDs

probe.sample_weight: exact1/channel_count per training patient, total1 per patient
probe.imputer: finite-feature TRAIN patient-weighted median; no finite TRAIN statistic -> stop, except intentional C0 constant zeros
probe.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN imputed rows with same patient-equal sample weights

bootstrap.unit: unique patient identities retain all FIT-fold appearances

diagnostics.channel_count_control: OLS paired patient AUROC gain ~intercept+log(channel_count/64)+(seizure_count-2)+original fold indicators centered at0.2; adjusted contrast at64 channels/2 seizures/equal-five-fold composition; same10000 ID draws refit OLS, descriptive not causal
diagnostics.stage_interventions: frozen C1 replace only early or only later context with C2 at same C1 threshold and frozen C1 preprocessor; no retraining; context-neutral standardized coordinates0 for contribution diagnostic

stop: no rescue, new stages, features, shuffle, normalization, classifier, seeds or TIDE/outer; passing only permits future proposal; other mixed gate failures use CONTINUATION_GATE_FAILED
scientific_limitations: existing cache-relative timing only, unresolved acquisition/EDF+D/raw generation provenance; no physiological normal-reference or causal propagation claim; extensively reused cohort
publish: source, hashes and nonidentifying aggregates only
